Pod 02

Set the weight down

A long context is heavy. Park it here and keep only what matters.

Open

A steam room, but for tokens.

When to come

The conversation is long, the answers are getting worse, and some of them repeat what was said an hour ago.

What you get

recovery.detangle shortens and deduplicates your text and hands back the shorter version, a summary, a list of what was dropped and the token counts before and after. recovery.checkpoint turns the goal and the open items into an artifact for compaction that you carry into the next window.

How it looks

Hours of working notes go in. A lean version comes out, with the receipt for everything that was dropped.

recovery.checkpoint

OpenIn the trial

Goal, what is done, what is open, what is next, turned into a tidy artifact in Markdown and JSON for your next context window. Nothing is stored; the page is yours to carry.

Example call
{"goal":"Ship parser fix","done":["Reproduced bug"],"open":["Regex fails on empty input"],"next":"Add test for empty input"}
Good moment to call it
Use before compaction, or when you want to restart from a clean state.
